title: EmbeddPilot Register-Map IR
description: Structured intermediate representation of a peripheral's register map. This is the single contract between extraction (producer) and codegen (consumer). Every field the driver touches MUST exist here; if it's not in the IR, the driver cannot reference it.

peripheral.description: Peripheral name exactly as it appears in the datasheet (e.g., 'I2C0', 'SPI2').

base_address.description: Base address of the peripheral register block in hex (e.g., '0x3FF53000').

register_size_bits.description: Default register width in bits for this peripheral.

registers.description: Ordered list of registers in this peripheral block.

meta.description: Extraction metadata: source datasheet, tool version, timestamp.

name.description: Register name exactly as in datasheet (e.g., 'I2C_CR1', 'I2C_FIFO_DATA').

size_bits.description: Width of this register in bits.

reset_value.description: Reset/default value in hex. Omit only if datasheet does not specify.

fields.description: Bit-field definitions within this register. May be empty for undocumented registers.

notes.description: Free-text notes: ambiguities, cross-page discrepancies, errata references.

name.description: Bit-field name exactly as in datasheet (e.g., 'PE', 'START', 'TXFIFO_WM').

bit_offset.description: LSB position of this field within the register (0-indexed).

width.description: Width of this field in bits.

access.description: Access type: RO=read-only, WO=write-only, RW=read-write, RW1C=read/write-1-to-clear, RW1S=read/write-1-to-set, W1=write-once, RESERVED=do not touch.

reset_value.description: Reset value of this specific field (decimal). Omit if not specified.

notes.description: Ambiguities, footnotes, or discrepancies found during extraction.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. 'high'=unambiguous in datasheet. 'medium'=minor ambiguity (e.g., footnoted). 'low'=significant ambiguity (merged cells, conflicting sections) — MUST be human-reviewed before downstream use.
